_comments: API SCOPES FOR THE ENTITLEMENT OPERATIONS (#347). Orders.CheckEntitlement and Orders.ListEntitlements declare
RequiredScope orders:entitlement-check and orders:entitlement-read (metadata/remote-operations). Without these
rows every API-key call to either operation is refused on a host that installs Orders, and nothing says why.
A parent `orders` with one child per operation, matching how MJ lays out its own scopes. The application
ceiling that allows them on MJAPI is in metadata/api-application-scopes. A host then only issues API keys.

fields.Name: orders
fields.Description: Parent scope for Orders remote operations

fields.Name: entitlement-check
fields.Description: Check whether a person holds an entitlement (Orders.CheckEntitlement)
